crew.overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.
crew.title: The Dark Knight Rises

crew.overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, even his humanity.
crew.title: Whiplash

details.biography:
Boman Rivera Modine is an award winning and Emmy-nominated Director, writer and producer. He has been working in the industry since 2010, beginning as a First Assistant Director and Editor. He has also consulted and produced with several production companies including Brain Academy, known for the Keanu Reeves/Peter Stormare show "Swedish Dicks", where he packaged both features and television shows.

His shorts have received acclaim and awards such as the Breath of Life award, the Best New Webseries award and has been featured as part of the Hollyshorts release on Delta and streaming platforms. He has received a BAFTA nomination for producing "The Party's Just Beginning" with Karen Gillan.
details.name: Boman Modine
